name: Disaster adjacent pairs: same incident? (80, blind)
instructions: Two event records from the SAME region and the SAME type, dated 0-3 days apart. Are they the same incident? SAME = one physical incident recorded twice (two reports, or an official act such as a ЧС declaration/mourning day plus a report of the incident it concerns). AFTERMATH = record B is a consequence or reaction to the incident in A (criticism, inspection, criminal case, evacuation update) rather than a new incident. DISTINCT = two different incidents (a new flood wave, a second fire elsewhere in the region, another building). Judge from the two texts; 'Unclear' is fine. Nothing shown is a model or database verdict.

options.label: B is AFTERMATH / reaction to A
